title: Ambient Lighting Features
summary: Feedback about ambient lighting centers on owners enjoying the interior lighting and color customization, with many other mentions being too brief or informational to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the ambient lighting as an appealing interior feature and highlight enjoyment of its color variety and customization.

negative.summary: Negative feedback is limited to a complaint that expected ambient lighting colors, especially red and blue with the M package, are missing.

neutral.summary: No explicit neutral reviews are present.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined mentions include brief references, feature descriptions, settings guidance, and ambiguous comments about lighting options, brightness, rear-seat lighting, or perceived quality.

limitations: Most topic mentions are assigned undetermined sentiment, which limits confidence in a fuller sentiment summary.
Several examples are very short or purely descriptive, so specific customer intent or evaluation cannot be determined from them alone.
Some undetermined fragments contain praise-like or complaint-like wording, but their supplied sentiment labels prevent reassigning them.
